text: Core Class Features
Blended Training

The Night Monarch gains a combat or magic talent every time she gains a class level, according to the class table. Night Monarchs use their Charisma modifier as their practitioner modifier and operative modifier.

text: Master of Night (Su)

The Night Monarch radiates an aura of dark authority. She gains a bonus on Intimidate checks equal to half her class level (minimum 1). Additionally, fiends, undead, and creatures with the evil subtype take a -2 penalty on saving throws against her abilities. At 10th level, this penalty increases to -4.

text: Dark Lore (Ex)

She may make Knowledge checks untrained, and adds half her class level to all Knowledge (arcana), Knowledge (planes), and Knowledge (religion) checks. Additionally, when she successfully identifies a creature's abilities or weaknesses, she gains a +1 insight bonus on attack rolls against that creature for 24 hours.

text: Bloodline Brands (Su)

As a full-round action, the Night Monarch may attempt to absorb the soul essence of a willing or recently defeated creature, creating a Bloodline Brand. She may only attempt absorption within a number of rounds equal to her class level after the creature's defeat. To absorb a creature, the Night Monarch rolls percentile dice. The base absorption chance is 25%, modified as follows: • +5% per class level • -5% per Hit Die the creature possesses • +10% if the creature is willing If the roll succeeds, the Night Monarch gains a Bloodline Brand tied to that creature's essence, granting her access to that brand's talent list. She may store a number of Bloodline Brands equal to her Bloodline Brands column. If she is already at maximum brands, she must choose one to permanently overwrite. Switching her active brand costs a full-round action.

text: Magatama (Su)

At 2nd level, the Night Monarch may customize up to three magatama — sacred gems she spends 8 hours attuning through meditation, ritual, and combat practice. Each magatama represents a unique configuration of power she has drilled into her fighting style. The number of magatama she may have customized simultaneously increases to 4 at 8th level and 5 at 14th level. Each magatama may contain a number of sphere talents equal to the Talents per Magatama column on the Night Monarch table. A magatama must contain a base sphere before additional talents from that sphere may be added, unless the Night Monarch already possesses that base sphere through another source such as Blended Training, the Extra Combat Talent feat, or multiclassing. Talents granted by a magatama cannot be used to qualify for feats or meet prerequisites unless otherwise noted. Spheres and talents that grant skill retraining never do so when gained through a magatama. The Night Monarch may only benefit from one magatama at a time — this is her active magatama. She may switch her active magatama as a swift action. She may customize a new magatama or alter an existing one by spending 8 hours, choosing which talents to lose and which to replace them with.

text: Archfiend Form (Su)

At 20th level, the Night Monarch permanently becomes an outsider. Her creature type changes to outsider (native) with the evil and extraplanar subtypes. She chooses one fiend subtype — devil (lawful), demon (chaotic), or daemon (neutral) — which cannot be changed. text: Genie Talents
